title: chore(storybook): update to v6 separator
body:
**Summary**

see https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/master/MIGRATION.md#simplified-hierarchy-separators for details, they changed the separator as well as adding a new parameter: https://storybook.js.org/docs/configurations/options-parameter/#showroots for the old behaviour

**Result**

It looks the same as before, but there's no warning anymore
